SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. SambaNova Internship Roles
About the SambaNova Summer Internship Program 
At SambaNova, our internship program is designed to give you hands-on experience tackling meaningful engineering challenges with real product impact. Because we are continuously evolving our program to provide the best possible experience, specific details and programming may vary by team and location, though you can generally expect the following: 

- Program Structure & Duration: Our summer internships are structured as a 12-week experience, kicking off with onboarding and orientation, followed by mid-program check-ins, and wrapping up with final project presentations to your team and key stakeholders. 
- Dedicated Mentorship: To support your growth, interns are typically paired with both a manager and a peer host/mentor who provide structured mentorship, technical guidance, and project alignment throughout the summer. 
- Locations & Onsite Experience: Roles are based onsite at one of our global hubs— including San Jose (HQ), Austin, Bangalore, or Stockholm—to foster direct collaboration, community, and hands-on exposure to our teams and technology. (Note: Specific location availability varies by role.) 
- Community & Engagement: Depending on your location and cohort schedule, programming may include leadership fireside chats, workshops, hackathons, lab tours, and social outings to help you connect with fellow interns and leaders across the company. 
- Feedback & Future Opportunities: Throughout the program, you will receive structured feedback on your technical depth, ownership, collaboration, and project impact. High-performing interns may be considered for returning internships or full time opportunities upon graduation, subject to business needs and performance.
About the Team 
The compiler team at SambaNova powers the RDU through a unique compilation strategy. By fusing kernels into dataflow graphs that run across the entire accelerator architecture, we avoid sequential kernel launches and eliminate the memory traffic that bottlenecks conventional hardware. This is a key differentiator and unlike any other product on the market. 
About the Role 
As a Compiler Engineer Intern, you'll work on a scoped project in a core area of our compiler, such as the IR and pass infrastructure, model lowering and partitioning, tensor tiling, memory management, or mapping operations onto the fabric. Compiler and hardware design are closely linked here, and you'll see how compiler decisions affect chip performance. You'll write real code in C++ and Python, debug at a low level, and work with the runtime and hardware teams. A dedicated mentor and senior engineers will review your code and guide you through your project. 
Responsibilities 

- Implement and test passes in the compiler's IR and pass infrastructure Help lower and partition machine learning models for execution on the RDU Contribute to tensor tiling and memory management for on-chip memory Explore how operations are mapped onto the RDU fabric to improve model performance 
- Debug compiler and performance issues in C++ and Python with guidance from your mentor 
- Present your project results to the team at the end of your internship 
Required Qualifications 

- Currently pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field 
- Coursework or project experience in machine learning systems, such as ML compilers, LLM inference kernels, or kernel generation 
- Solid programming skills in Python and C/C++ 
- Exposure to programming GPUs or otherAI accelerators 
Preferred Qualifications 

- Pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field 
- Familiarity with ML compiler frameworks such as MLIR or StableHLO 
- Familiarity with LLM kernel libraries 
- Machine learning systems research experience 
- Open source project ownership or contributions 
- Experience building AI agent driven tools or automation 
Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. 
EEO Policy
SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

About the Team 
The AI Performance team brings up and optimizes foundation models such as DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, and GPT OSS on SambaNova's dataflow platform. We profile and tune models across the compiler, runtime, and hardware layers to improve inference throughput and latency. 
About the Role 
As an AI Performance Engineer Intern, you'll help bring up open source models on the SambaNova stack and work to make them run faster. You'll profile model execution, find bottlenecks, and try optimizations such as quantization, kernel fusion, and improved scheduling with the compiler, runtime, and hardware teams. A dedicated mentor will guide you throughout the internship. 
Responsibilities 

- Help bring up foundation models on the SambaNova platform using our software stack 
- Profile model performance across the compiler, runtime, and hardware layers Identify bottlenecks and propose dataflow or scheduling optimizations Apply techniques from recent research in quantization, scheduling, and memory optimization 
- Benchmark throughput and latency and track performance changes across release
- Work with the machine learning, compiler, runtime, and hardware teams on your project 
- Present your project results to the team at the end of your internship 
Required Qualifications 

- Currently pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
- Solid programming skills in Python or C++ 
- Understanding of algorithms, data structures, and numerical computing Coursework or project experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX 
- Familiarity with inference frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT, or SGLang Exposure to GPU programming with CUDA or Triton 
Preferred Qualifications 

- Pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
- Experience with LLM training or inference 
- Familiarity with quantization, graph optimization, kernel fusion, or model partitioning Knowledge of memory hierarchy, caching, and scheduling for large model execution Prior internship or research experience in ML systems or performance optimization Publications or open source contributions in ML systems

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.   
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Build your career with Jabil! We challenge and empower you to make most of your talents, working with outstanding colleagues from diverse backgrounds who share your drive and passion to make Jabil grow!
 JOB SUMMARY 
A data science intern is a trainee who wants to gain working experience in the field of data science. Data science interns assist data scientists in collecting, analyzing, and interpret data sets to drive optimization and improvement of product development. As part of the company's trainees, Machine learning and Generative AI interns are expected to assist in designing and implementing advanced ML pipelines and Gen‑AI solutions, including developing, training, and optimizing models to address complex real‑world problems. Data science interns must also coordinate with different functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes.

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
• Identifies and analyzes patterns in the performance of machine learning models, the types of Gen‑AI outputs produced (e.g., text, images), and the speed or unexpected variations in model behavior during training and inference. 
• Educates the organization both from IT and the business perspectives on new approaches, such as testing hypotheses and statistical validation of results, LLM model evaluation etc. 
• Works with engineering and data science teams to support model training, fine‑tuning, and deployment workflows, ensuring that machine learning and generative AI systems are properly integrated, monitored, and optimized based on business requirements. 
• Build dashboards 
• Conducts basic data analysis 
 JOB QUALIFICATIONS & KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENT S
 
• Proficient in Python/R, Cloud techniques development experience is plus 
 
• Familiar with regression models (i.e., xgboosting, lightGBM etc.), classification models (i.e., logistic regression, SVM, etc.), cluster models is preferred 
• Familiarity with generative AI models (e.g., GPT‑based large language models, diffusion models), prompt engineering techniques, and model fine‑tuning or customization is preferred. 
• Strong statistics knowledge is plus 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in teams and under pressure. Multi-lingual capability is a plus 
• Highly motivated and creative, thinking “out of the box” 
• Strong team mentality, interpersonal and communications skills 
• Enthusiasm and ability to seek out and learn new technologies and algorithms outside of your immediate toolset/knowledge to solve business problems where required 
 
 EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND & EXPERIENC E
 
• Senior or recent graduate with a Bachelor or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or Statistics 

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact the Federal Bureau of Investigations internet crime hotline (www.ic3.gov), the Federal Trade Commission identity theft hotline (www.identitytheft.gov) and/or your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in. 
 Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

 Accessibility Accommodation   
 
If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always_Accessible@Jabil.com or calling 727-803-7988 with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail or phone number. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.
